name: Ijikwa Ọrụ n'Ụzọ Agile
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị nkọwa otu ọrụ, ịkọwa otu Agile si arụ ọrụ n'obere oge nkenke na mgbe waterfall dabara karịa, n'okwu nke gị, ya na otu ọmụmaatụ nke ọ bụla
Mgbe e nyere gị obere otu Scrum, ịkpọ aha ọrụ atọ ndị Scrum, mmemme ise na ihe atọ (artifacts), ma nweta opekata mpe 9 n'ime 11 ziri ezi
Maka ezi ọrụ nke izu abụọ ruo izu isii, ide backlog nwere opekata mpe user stories asatọ nwere acceptance criteria, n'usoro mkpa, ebe story ọ bụla na-agbaso usoro "As a..., I want... so that..."

Mgbe e nyere gị backlog gị na awa ị nwere n'ezie, ịhazi sprint nke otu izu nwere sprint goal nke otu ahịrịokwu na ọrụ ndị na-ewe otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ obere, nke mere na ọrụ a hazịrị dabara n'oge ị nwere
N'oge sprint gị, iso ọrụ ahụ na bọọdụ ọrụ nwere WIP limit na nzukọ nkeji 15 kwa ụbọchị, na-ebugharị kaadị ọ bụla ka ọrụ na-aga
Na njedebe sprint gị, ime sprint review na retrospective Keep, Stop, Try ma tinye otu mmezi na sprint na-esote, ya na ndụmọdụ e dere n'ime backlog

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ihe Agile bụ, na otu o si dị iche na nnukwu atụmatụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 4
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa n'okwu nke gị otu Agile si arụ ọrụ n'obere oge nkenke.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị nkọwa otu ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa otu Agile si arụ ọrụ n'obere oge nkenke na mgbe waterfall dabara karịa, n'okwu nke gị, ya na otu ọmụmaatụ nke ọ bụla.
N'ọrụ ochie ma ọ bụ "waterfall", ị na-ebu ụzọ hazie ihe niile, wee wuo ya, wee nwalee ya, wee nyefee ya na njedebe. Nke a na-arụ ọrụ mgbe a maara ọrụ ahụ nke ọma, dị ka ịwụ ntọala ụlọ. Ọ naghị arụ ọrụ mgbe ihe a chọrọ gbanwere n'etiti.
Agile na-enyefe ihe n'obere oge nkenke, ọtụtụ mgbe otu izu ruo izu anọ. Oge ọ bụla na-arụpụta ihe a pụrụ iji, otu ahụ na-egosi ya ndị e mere ya maka ha, a na-agbanwekwa atụmatụ dabere n'ihe ha kwuru. Agile Manifesto (2001) kwuru ya n'ụzọ dị mfe: ihe na-arụ ọrụ na ịnabata mgbanwe dị mkpa karịa ịgbaso atụmatụ a kpọchiri akpọchi.
Scrum na Kanban bụ ụzọ abụọ a na-ejikarị eme Agile. Scrum na-eji oge ogologo ya kwụ ọtọ a na-akpọ sprint. Kanban na-eji bọọdụ na ọrụ na-aga n'ihu nwayọọ nwayọọ, ya na oke n'ọnụ ọgụgụ ọrụ na-aga n'otu oge. Ị nwere ike iji echiche sitere n'ha abụọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Agile: ụzọ isi arụ ọrụ n'obere oge nkenke, na-elele ma na-agbanwe ihe ugboro ugboro.
- Waterfall: ụzọ isi arụ ọrụ ebe a na-emecha otu akụkụ tupu nke ọzọ amalite.
- Scrum: ụzọ Agile na-arụ ọrụ n'oge ogologo ya kwụ ọtọ a na-akpọ sprint.
- Kanban: ụzọ Agile na-eji bọọdụ ma na-egbochi ọrụ ole na-aga n'otu oge.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Manifesto for Agile Software Development (n'asụsụ bekee)
- The Scrum Guide (2020) (n'asụsụ bekee)
Nwaa ugbu a: Họrọ otu ezi ọrụ ị chọrọ imecha n'ime izu abụọ ruo izu isii na-abịa. Dee otu ahịrịokwu na-akọwa ya na otu ahịrịokwu banyere ndị ọ bụ maka ha.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa otu Agile si dị iche na nnukwu atụmatụ e mere na mbido, ma kpọọ aha Scrum na Kanban.

options: Atụmatụ izu anọ a kpọchiri akpọchi
Ụzọ isi eme Agile site na bọọdụ na oke n'ọrụ na-aga
check.why: Kanban na-eji bọọdụ na ọrụ na-aga n'ihu nwayọọ, ya na oke n'ọnụ ọgụgụ ọrụ na-aga n'otu oge.

check.q: Otu ndị agha mbụ gị na-ewu weebụsaịtị ọhụrụ, ndị otu na-agbanwekwa ihe ha chọrọ mgbe niile. Kedu ụzọ dabara?
options: Waterfall: hazie ihe niile na mbido ma nyefee na njedebe
Agile: nyefee n'obere oge nkenke ma gbanwee mgbe nke ọ bụla gwụrụ
Chere ruo mgbe onye ọ bụla kwenyere n'ihe niile
check.why: Agile dabara ọrụ ebe ihe a chọrọ na-agbanwe, n'ihi na a na-egosi oge ọ bụla ma gbanwee atụmatụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Ọrụ, mmemme na ihe (artifacts) Scrum
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kpọọ aha onye na-eme gịnị na Scrum na mmemme ise sprint na-eji.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị obere otu Scrum, ị ga-enwe ike ịkpọ aha ọrụ atọ ndị Scrum, mmemme ise na ihe atọ (artifacts), ma nweta opekata mpe 9 n'ime 11 ziri ezi.
The Scrum Guide (nke 2020) kpọrọ aha ọrụ atọ (accountabilities). Product Owner na-ekpebi ihe kacha mkpa ma na-edebe ndepụta ọrụ n'usoro. Developers bụ ndị na-arụ ọrụ ahụ, ụdị ọrụ ọ bụla, ọ bụghị naanị software. Scrum Master na-enyere otu ahụ aka ịgbaso Scrum ma na-ewepụ ihe mgbochi.
E nwere mmemme ise. Sprint bụ igbe na-ejide ihe niile, otu ọnwa ma ọ bụ obere. Sprint Planning na-ekpebi sprint goal ma họrọ ọrụ. Daily Scrum bụ nlele nkeji 15 maka ọganihu gaa n'ebumnuche ahụ. Sprint Review na-egosi ihe a rụpụtara nye ndị e mere ya maka ha. Sprint Retrospective na-ele otu otu ahụ si rụọ ọrụ ma họrọ mmezi.
E nwere ihe atọ (artifacts): Product Backlog (ọrụ niile, n'usoro), Sprint Backlog (ọrụ a họọrọ maka sprint a) na Increment (ihe a pụrụ iji a rụpụtara). N'obere ọrụ, otu onye nwere ike ijide ihe karịrị otu ọrụ. Nke ahụ dị mma ma ọ bụrụhaala na e mere ọrụ ọ bụla.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Product Owner: onye na-ekpebi ọrụ kacha mkpa ma na-ahazi backlog n'usoro.
- Scrum Master: onye na-enyere otu aka iji Scrum nke ọma ma na-ewepụ ihe mgbochi.
- Increment: ihe a pụrụ iji nke sprint rụpụtara.
- Retrospective: nzukọ na njedebe sprint banyere otu otu ahụ si rụọ ọrụ; ọ yiri after-action review.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- The Scrum Guide (2020) (n'asụsụ bekee)
Nwaa ugbu a: Maka ọrụ gị, dee onye ga-abụ Product Owner, Scrum Master na Developers. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ naanị gị, dee okpu ị ga-eyi na mmemme ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha ọrụ atọ Scrum, mmemme ise na ihe atọ (artifacts), ma kenye ha n'ọrụ gị.

options: Ihe a pụrụ iji nke sprint rụpụtara
check.why: Increment bụ ihe a pụrụ iji a rụpụtara; Product Backlog bụ ndepụta ọrụ niile.

check.q: Ọ bụ naanị gị nọ n'obere ọrụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme banyere ọrụ Scrum?
options: Kwụsị, n'ihi na Scrum chọrọ opekata mpe mmadụ atọ
Buru ụzọ were Scrum Master n'ọrụ
Jide ihe karịrị otu ọrụ ma hụ na e mere ọrụ ọ bụla
check.why: N'obere ọrụ, otu onye nwere ike ijide ihe karịrị otu ọrụ, ma ọ bụrụhaala na e mere ọrụ ọ bụla.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ide user stories na iwu backlog
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Mee ka ọrụ bụrụ backlog nke user stories n'usoro mkpa, nwere njedebe doro anya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Maka ezi ọrụ nke izu abụọ ruo izu isii, ị ga-enwe ike ide backlog nwere opekata mpe user stories asatọ nwere acceptance criteria, n'usoro mkpa, ebe story ọ bụla na-agbaso usoro "As a..., I want... so that...".
User story na-akọwa otu akụkụ ọrụ site n'anya onye ọ na-enyere aka: "As a [ụdị mmadụ], I want [ihe] so that [ihe kpatara ya]." N'Igbo: "Dị ka [ụdị mmadụ], achọrọ m [ihe] ka [ihe kpatara ya]." Ọmụmaatụ: "Dị ka onye na-ewe mmadụ n'ọrụ, achọrọ m résumé nwere otu peeji ka m hụ nka onye ahụ ngwa ngwa."
Story ọ bụla chọrọ acceptance criteria: nlele abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ na-ekwu mgbe e mechara ya. Maka story résumé: ọ dabara n'otu peeji, o nwere ihe atọ a rụpụtara nke a pụrụ ịtụ, o nweghị mperi nsụpe. Njedebe doro anya na-egbochi esemokwu n'ikpeazụ.
Hazie stories n'usoro: nke kacha baa uru na nke kacha ngwa n'elu. Ngwa enyemaka AI dị ka ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot ma ọ bụ Google Gemini nwere ike inyere gị aka ide stories mbụ site na nkọwa ọrụ, mana gị na-ekpebi usoro ma lelee na story ọ bụla bụ ezi ọrụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Depụta ihe niile ọrụ ahụ chọrọ, otu ihe n'otu ahịrị.
- Degharịa ihe ọ bụla dị ka "As a..., I want... so that...".
- Tinye acceptance criteria abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ na nke ọ bụla.
- Kewaa story ọ bụla buru oke ibu imecha n'otu sprint.
- Hazie stories n'usoro mkpa, site n'elu ruo ala.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- User story: nkọwa dị mkpụmkpụ nke ọrụ site n'anya onye ọ na-enyere aka.
- Acceptance criteria: nlele ndị na-ekwu na e mechara story.
- Backlog: ndepụta ọrụ niile maka ọrụ ahụ, n'usoro.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee opekata mpe user stories asatọ maka ọrụ gị, nke ọ bụla nwere acceptance criteria, ma hazie ha n'usoro mkpa. Ị nwere ike ịjụ ngwa enyemaka AI: "Turn this project into user stories with acceptance criteria" wee dozie ihe ọ dere.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide user stories nwere acceptance criteria ma hazie ha ka ha bụrụ backlog.

check.q: Gịnị ka akụkụ "so that" (ka...) nke user story na-enye?
options: Ihe mere ọrụ ahụ ji dị mkpa
check.why: "So that" na-ekwu ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ uru ọ ga-abara onye story ahụ na-enyere aka.

check.q: Ngwa enyemaka AI dere stories maka mmemme obodo gị. Otu bụ "Hazie mmemme ahụ dum". Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Kewaa ya ka ọ bụrụ obere stories ga-adaba n'otu sprint
Mee ka ọ bụrụ story kacha elu
Tinye ya na sprint ọ bụla
check.why: Story buru oke ibu maka otu sprint kwesịrị ka e kewaa ya n'obere akụkụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ịhazi sprint nwere ebumnuche doro anya
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Hazie sprint nke otu izu ma ọ bụ izu abụọ nwere sprint goal na ọrụ ruru eru.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị backlog gị na awa ị nwere n'ezie, ị ga-enwe ike ịhazi sprint nke otu izu nwere sprint goal nke otu ahịrịokwu na ọrụ ndị na-ewe otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ obere, nke mere na ọrụ a hazịrị dabara n'oge ị nwere.
Sprint Planning na-aza ajụjụ atọ: gịnị mere sprint a ji baa uru (sprint goal), gịnị ka a pụrụ ime (stories ndị e họọrọ), na olee otu a ga-esi mee ya (ọrụ ndị ahụ).
Sprint goal bụ otu ahịrịokwu, dị ka commander's intent (ebumnuche ọchịagha): "Tupu Fraịde, aga m enwe résumé m mechara na arịrịọ ọrụ ise e zipụrụ, nke ọ bụla dabara n'ọrụ ya." Ọ bụrụ na atụmatụ agbanwee n'etiti, ebumnuche ahụ na-agwa onye ọ bụla ihe ka dị mkpa.
Were stories site n'elu backlog ruo mgbe oge otu ahụ jupụtara, ma hapụ ohere ntakịrị. Otu ọhụrụ fọrọ nke nta ka ha na-ahazi ọrụ karịrị akarị mgbe niile. Kewaa story ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ ọrụ ndị na-ewe otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ obere.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kpebie ogologo sprint (otu izu ma ọ bụ izu abụọ dị mma maka ndị mbido).
- Dee sprint goal nke otu ahịrịokwu.
- Were stories site n'elu backlog nke na-enyere ebumnuche ahụ aka.
- Kewaa story ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ ọrụ ndị na-ewe otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ obere.
- Tụnyere ngụkọta ya na awa ị nwere n'ezie, ma belata ma ọ dị mkpa.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Sprint goal: otu ahịrịokwu na-ekwu ihe sprint ahụ chọrọ imezu.
- Capacity: oge ole otu ahụ nwere n'ezie n'oge sprint.
Nwaa ugbu a: Hazie sprint nke otu izu maka ọrụ gị: dee sprint goal, họrọ stories, kewaa ha ka ha bụrụ ọrụ, ma tụnyere ha na awa ị nwere n'ezie n'izu a.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịhazi sprint nwere ebumnuche, stories e họọrọ na ọrụ dabara n'ezi oge gị.

check.q: Ogologo oge ole ka ọrụ dị na atụmatụ sprint kwesịrị iwe?
options: Otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ obere
check.why: Ịkewa stories ka ha bụrụ ọrụ na-ewe otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ obere na-eme ka ọ dị mfe iso ọganihu.

check.q: N'etiti sprint, atụmatụ gbanwere. Gịnị na-agwa otu ahụ ihe ka dị mkpa?
options: Onye ọ bụla na-ekwu okwu kacha ike
check.why: Dị ka commander's intent, sprint goal na-ekwu ihe ka dị mkpa mgbe atụmatụ gbanwere.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ịrụ ọrụ na bọọdụ ọrụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Hazie bọọdụ ọrụ ma jiri nzukọ kwa ụbọchị mee ka ọrụ na-aga n'ihu.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'oge sprint gị, ị ga-enwe ike iso ọrụ ahụ na bọọdụ ọrụ nwere WIP limit na nzukọ nkeji 15 kwa ụbọchị, na-ebugharị kaadị ọ bụla ka ọrụ na-aga.
Bọọdụ ọrụ (task board) na-egosi ọrụ n'ogidi: To Do (ime), In Progress (na-aga) na Done (emechaala). Ọrụ ọ bụla bụ kaadị na-aga n'aka nri ka ọrụ na-aga. Ị nwere ike iji mpempe akwụkwọ nrapado na mgbidi, spreadsheet, ma ọ bụ ngwa bọọdụ n'efu dị ka Trello, Microsoft Planner ma ọ bụ GitHub Projects.
Kanban na-agbakwunye oke n'ọrụ na-aga (WIP limit): dịka ọmụmaatụ, kaadị abụọ n'ime In Progress n'otu onye, ọ gaghị agafe ya. Imecha ọrụ ka mma karịa ịmalite ọrụ ọhụrụ.
Daily Scrum bụ nkeji 15. Onye ọ bụla na-akọ ọganihu ya gaa na sprint goal, ihe na-esote, na ihe ọ bụla na-egbochi ya. A na-edozi ihe mgbochi mgbe nzukọ ahụ gwụrụ, ọ bụghị n'oge ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Mee ogidi atọ: To Do, In Progress, Done.
- Tinye otu kaadị maka ọrụ ọ bụla dị na atụmatụ sprint gị.
- Debe WIP limit, dị ka kaadị abụọ n'ime In Progress.
- Kwa ụbọchị, bugharịa kaadị ma mee nzukọ nkeji 15.
- Dee ihe mgbochi na onye ga-ewepụ ha.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Bọọdụ ọrụ (task board): bọọdụ nwere ogidi na-egosi ebe ọrụ ọ bụla dị.
- WIP limit: oke n'ọnụ ọgụgụ ọrụ nwere ike ịga n'otu oge (WIP: work in progress).
- Ihe mgbochi (blocker): ihe ọ bụla na-egbochi ọrụ ịga n'ihu.
Nwaa ugbu a: Wuo bọọdụ ọrụ maka sprint gị nwere ogidi atọ na otu kaadị maka ọrụ ọ bụla. Debe WIP limit. N'ime ụbọchị atọ na-abịa, bugharịa kaadị ma dee nzukọ kwa ụbọchị n'ahịrị abụọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịrụ sprint na bọọdụ ọrụ nwere WIP limit na nzukọ dị mkpụmkpụ kwa ụbọchị.

check.q: Kedu ihe atọ onye ọ bụla na-akọ na Daily Scrum?
options: Ụgwọ ọnwa ya, ọkwa ya na awa ya
Nkọwa niile nke ọrụ ọ bụla
Ọganihu gaa n'ebumnuche, ihe na-esote na ihe mgbochi ọ bụla
check.why: Daily Scrum bụ nlele dị mkpụmkpụ maka ọganihu gaa na sprint goal, ihe na-esote na ihe mgbochi.

check.q: I mechara otu ọrụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme kaadị ya?
options: Tụfuo ya tupu onye ọ bụla ahụ ya
check.why: Kaadị na-aga n'aka nri ka ọrụ na-aga, ya mere ọrụ e mechara na-aga Done.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Imechi sprint: nyocha na retrospective
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Mee sprint review na retrospective ma mee ka ha bụrụ otu mgbanwe maka sprint na-esote.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Na njedebe sprint gị, ị ga-enwe ike ime sprint review na retrospective Keep, Stop, Try ma tinye otu mmezi na sprint na-esote, ya na ndụmọdụ e dere n'ime backlog.
Sprint Review na-egosi ọrụ e mechara nye ndị e mere ya maka ha ma jụọ ihe ha chere. Gosi naanị ọrụ ruru acceptance criteria ya. Ndụmọdụ ha na-alaghachi n'ime backlog.
Sprint Retrospective bụ maka otu i si rụọ ọrụ, ọ bụghị ihe i wuru. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka after-action review: ihe kwesịrị ime, ihe mere, ihe kpatara ya, na ihe a ga-eme n'ụzọ dị iche. Usoro dị mfe bụ Keep, Stop, Try (Gaa n'ihu, Kwụsị, Nwalee).
Họrọ otu mmezi ma tinye ya na sprint na-esote dị ka ezi ọrụ. Retrospective na-adịghị agbanwe ihe ọ bụla bụ naanị nzukọ. Asambodo Agile, dị ka Certified ScrumMaster site na Scrum Alliance ma ọ bụ Professional Scrum Master site na Scrum.org, nwere ike ịbịa mgbe e mesịrị; lelee weebụsaịtị ha maka ihe a chọrọ na ụgwọ ugbu a.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Depụta ihe e mechara nke ruru acceptance criteria ya.
- Gosi ya ndị e mere ya maka ha ma dee ndụmọdụ ha.
- Tinye ndụmọdụ ahụ n'ime backlog.
- Mee retrospective Keep / Stop / Try.
- Tinye otu mmezi na sprint na-esote.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Sprint Review: nzukọ iji gosi ọrụ e mechara ma nweta ndụmọdụ.
- After-action review: nnyocha ndị agha mgbe ọrụ gwụrụ: ihe a hazịrị, ihe mere na ihe a ga-agbanwe.
- Keep / Stop / Try: usoro retrospective dị mfe: gaa n'ihu, kwụsị, nwalee.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Scrum Alliance: Certified ScrumMaster (n'asụsụ bekee)
- Ule Scrum.org (n'asụsụ bekee)
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: mechaa sprint gị nke otu izu. Dee sprint review dị mkpụmkpụ (ihe e mechara, onye hụrụ ya, ihe ha kwuru) na retrospective Keep / Stop / Try, wee tinye otu mmezi na sprint na-esote.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike imechi sprint site na nyocha na retrospective ma buru otu mmezi banye na sprint na-esote.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Backlog nke user stories Stories erughị asatọ, ma ọ bụ ihe e dere dị ka ọrụ nkịtị na-enweghị "so that". Opekata mpe stories asatọ n'usoro ahụ, nke ọ bụla nwere acceptance criteria abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ, n'usoro mkpa. E kewara nnukwu stories, onye na-amụ ihe nwekwara ike ịkọwa ihe mere story kacha elu ji bụrụ nke mbụ. Atụmatụ sprint Enweghị sprint goal, ma ọ bụ ọrụ ahụ karịrị oge dị. Sprint goal nke otu ahịrịokwu, stories sitere n'elu backlog na ọrụ ndị na-ewe otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ obere dabara n'awa ndị ahụ. Ọ hapụrụ ohere ntakịrị ma kwuo ihe a ga-ebu ụzọ belata. Bọọdụ ọrụ E hazịrị bọọdụ ahụ mana a bugharịghị kaadị n'izu ahụ. Ogidi To Do, In Progress na Done, WIP limit, na kaadị a na-ebugharị kwa ụbọchị. E dere ihe mgbochi ya na onye wepụrụ ha. Nyocha na retrospective Nyocha (review) ma ọ bụ retrospective adịghị. Nyocha e dere ede nwere ndụmọdụ a tinyere na backlog, na Keep, Stop na Try e depụtara. Otu mmezi abụrụlarị ọrụ na sprint na-esote. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Retrospective kacha yie omume ndị agha ole?
check.why: Dị ka after-action review, ọ na-ajụ ihe a hazịrị, ihe mere, ihe kpatara ya, na ihe a ga-agbanwe.

check.q: Otu gị depụtara ihe ise a ga-anwale na sprint na-esote. Gịnị na-eme ka retrospective ahụ baa uru?
options: Họrọ otu ma tinye ya na sprint na-esote dị ka ezi ọrụ
Mee nzukọ ọzọ iji kparịta ha
check.why: Otu mmezi e mere ka ọ bụrụ ezi ọrụ bụ ihe na-agbanwe otu otu ahụ si arụ ọrụ.
